correctness.rationale: Writing e1=s1+s2+s3, e2=Σsisj,e3=s1s2s3,P=Π(1+ωsi), choosing K>max(e1+1/ω+ωe3/s1,P/ω), r=aK, β=a(K−e1−1/ω), σ=aP/ω, μ large and α=aωe3/μ ensures all parameters and I(si)=βsi/μ−α positive. Direct nullcline elimination gives exact identity F(S)=−aωΠ(S−si)/(S(1+ωS)), an at-most cubic positive coexistence equation. At roots, g_I=−μτ_i<0 and det J=aμωτ_i Π_{j≠i}(si−sj)/(1+ωsi), giving +−+; f_S=H_i and μ>max H_i^+/τ_i forces traces negative at all roots, so outer sinks and intermediate saddle. r>σ makes disease-free Q(S) concave quadratic with positive constant and exactly one positive root. Nonzero det, strict inequalities, and the persistent cubic bound justify robust seven-parameter open realization by IFT. Independent exact rational arithmetic checked example (130,130,106,20/53,126,1,106), I coordinates 33/53,86/53,1040/53 and determinants 627,−516,11856/7 with traces −71/2,−60,−828/7. This exact example supports, but is not substituted for, arbitrary-triple algebraic proof.

value.rationale: The universal constructive triple-realization theorem turns an algebraic upper bound of three coexistence equilibria into a robust simultaneous two-attractor endemic bistability mechanism in the exact ecological model. Requiring positive epidemiological parameters, exactly one disease-free positive root, and stability signs for every prescribed triple makes the result substantively stronger than numerical multistability examples.
residual_risks: Only local hyperbolic attractors, not global basin geometry or empirical realism; adding diffusion changes stability.

final_claim: For every prescribed 0<s1<s2<s3, the undelayed Liu–Zhang forest disease–fire ODE has strictly positive parameter choices with exactly those three coexistence susceptible densities, the outer two hyperbolic sinks and the middle a saddle; this persists under all small independent parameter perturbations and may occur with a unique positive disease-free equilibrium.
limitations: Example verifies feasibility but never establishes arbitrary triple by itself; full algebraic identity and positivity inequalities are necessary.
Robustness is local in all seven parameters; global dynamics, diffusion, stochastic/delayed extensions not claimed.
